title: OpenBuildings Designer workflows and connector status
description: Explore OpenBuildings Designer workflow ideas in Vector OS. Connector status: Upcoming. Development and release dates have not been announced.

OpenBuildings Designer

OpenBuildings Designer supports multidisciplinary building design and information-rich project delivery.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Model an architectural system

Use the selected building, infrastructure or plant elements and their current parameters. In the intended OpenBuildings Designer preview, model an architectural system; the visible result is an updated model view that identifies each affected element. Review levels, connectivity, classification and design intent before accepting or exporting it.

Coordinate building services

Start from the coordinated discipline context and current issue set. In the intended OpenBuildings Designer preview, coordinate building services; the visible result is a comparison, check or automation result linked to model objects. Review element identity, clashes, rules and downstream effects before accepting or exporting it.

Issue federated documentation

Begin with the accepted model proposal and document set. In the intended OpenBuildings Designer preview, issue federated documentation; the visible result is updated schedules, drawings or issue information derived from the same subject. Review coordination status, quantities and publication scope before accepting or exporting it.
